name: One day with 1701
source:
In this game you have to spend one day with 1701, your new friend. You can consider it a meeting, a date, whatever you want! The main thing is to make sure that everything goes perfectly!

[From [url=https://bloody-moonlight.itch.io/one-day-with-1701]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个游戏中，你必须和你的新朋友1701一起度过一天。你可以将其视为一次会议、一次约会，无论你想要什么！最重要的是确保一切顺利！

[来自[url=https://bloody-moonlight.itch.io/one-day-with-1701]itch.io[/url]]
